name: SpecCoverageGate
objective: Create the coverage gate that measures whether specs, rules, features, layers, languages, tests and runtime capabilities are sufficiently connected before future implementation phases proceed.
why_now: P7 created a compact world model. P8 must turn that world model into measurable coverage gates so future agents can detect missing specs, weak test coverage, layer/language blind spots and stale documentation before implementation.
must_not_create: runtime-heavy ContextQuant implementation before SpecCoverageGate exists
success_conditions: P9 FolderNotes + NotePlans receives coverage constraints
